name: Threat Map
description: Live world threat map showing blocked attacks targeting your infrastructure, with animated attack arcs, country statistics and a real-time event feed.

USE_THREAT_MAP.help: Enable the threat map page in the web UI.
USE_THREAT_MAP.label: Threat map

THREAT_MAP_MAX_EVENTS.help: Maximum number of recent blocked requests sent to the browser for the map animation and feed.
THREAT_MAP_MAX_EVENTS.label: Threat map max events

THREAT_MAP_HOME_LAT.help: Latitude of your infrastructure, used as the target of the attack arcs on the map.
THREAT_MAP_HOME_LAT.label: Threat map home latitude

THREAT_MAP_HOME_LON.help: Longitude of your infrastructure, used as the target of the attack arcs on the map.
THREAT_MAP_HOME_LON.label: Threat map home longitude

THREAT_MAP_HOME_LABEL.help: Label displayed next to the home marker on the map.
THREAT_MAP_HOME_LABEL.label: Threat map home label
